description: Fetch GitHub/Gitee by URL: README, file (/blob/, lines), tree, issue, PR, commit, releases, or repo symbol search ('symbol'). Example: https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/src/index.ts — ref can be branch/tag/commit; not a repo clone.

lines.description: Optional source-file line range, 1-based inclusive (e.g. "120-180"). Only valid for /blob/ URLs; URL hash #L120-L180 also works.

maxResults.description: Optional max number of symbol search results to return (1-20, default 5).

ref.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit for symbol search (defaults to repo default branch).

releaseLimit.description: Optional number of releases to return for /releases URLs (1-30, default 10).

symbol.description: Optional code symbol to search in the repository (e.g. "Use", "RouterGroup", "createContext"). Performs fast whole-repo syntactic search.

name: fetchGithubContent
